summary: Telaid is a technology integrator that designs, deploys, and supports multi-site enterprise technology programs (wireless, physical security, cabling/infrastructure, IoT, POS staging/configuration) exclusively for multi-site clients, with QSR named as a core vertical alongside retail, financial services, and logistics; the company states over 40 years in business.

Telaid announced a definitive agreement on November 26, 2019 to acquire Technology Deployment Company (TDC), an Oklahoma-based technology integrator with 10+ years serving QSR, retail, and education clients across the US, Canada, and parts of Europe/Asia, with the deal set to close at year-end 2019; Telaid CEO Chris Patsiga and TDC CEO Doug Oglesby both issued statements on the combination. (Scope note: This is a 2019 event, not recent — included only to establish Telaid's multi-site QSR deployment scale and M&A history; no 2024-2026 activity was found in this pass.)
